_comment: RECOGNIZABILITY prune — album cuts / deep tracks by famous artists that fail the 'everyone knows it' test as a tap-your-foot anchor. Hand-flagged in a data-quality review (2026-07). Same rationale as exclude-obscure.json (recognizability, NOT popularity score); split into its own file only so the review batch stays reviewable. Key = 'artist|title' (case/punctuation normalized at load). Delete a line to re-include. Auto-globbed by build.mjs (^exclude.*\.json$).
